## Retry Handler

Single Responsibility: custom-backoff HTTP retry for calls that need more than n8n's native per-node retry (e.g. respecting a Retry-After header from BudgetFlow's rate limiter).

Most workflows should just use the built-in retryOnFail / maxTries / waitBetweenTries settings already configured on each node in 03-budgetflow-api-client — that covers the common case with zero extra hops. Reach for this utility only when you need Retry-After-aware backoff or a longer retry budget than 3 attempts.

Input: { method, url, headers?, body?, maxRetries? } (default maxRetries = 3)
Output: { ok, statusCode, body, attempts, error }
